answers.rationale: She repeatedly accepts a modest event-hotel premium when it removes conference-day movement, particularly when meeting breakfast is already provided. She also consistently treats a request-only refrigerator as a follow-up item and keeps a practical breakfast/appliance backup until it is resolved. Capitol additionally best protects the late arrival with its on-site restaurant.

On personal trips, Marisol has repeatedly favored included breakfast and explicitly listed in-room coffee and refrigeration over boutique appeal or modest price differences. Riverfront Hampton preserves those practicalities while remaining an easy walk to the museum and nearby dinner, making Warehouse's closer, more stylish room insufficient to outweigh its missing room basics.

For no-car work visits, she repeatedly selects the option that combines included breakfast, confirmed in-room coffee and refrigerator, and a manageable early-morning ride. Arts District Hampton is cheaper than East End while avoiding its request-only refrigerator and paid breakfast, and its six-minute pickup ride is well within her established tolerance.

Once breakfast and room appliances are equivalent, Marisol generally chooses the lower-friction, value-oriented base with reliable nearby dinner rather than paying a modest premium for a bar, broader scene, or higher rating. Midtown is closer to sessions and has same-block dinner for the late arrival, whereas Riverwalk's upgrades do not solve a stronger trip need.
